environment: Xvfb X11, Mesa llvmpipe, isolated synthetic stage 3 save
symptom: Root-window captures became black after Escape on the skill-selection panel; clicking the middle skill still selected it and resumed visible battle.
comparisons: Before/after Escape: scene, layer visibility, matrices, texture IDs/validity, vertex/color/texture-coordinate buffers, viewport, blend/depth/alpha/scissor state unchanged; only elapsed game tick differed.

interpretation: The game rendered the panel correctly into GL_BACK while X11 capture/presentation was black. The underlying presentation/capture cause remains unresolved; this is not a fixed gameplay defect or a physical-desktop validation.
